answer: Randomized honeypot audits resist sybils: the protocol secretly plants bad answers — a walnut among good seed — and any grader who approves one is slashed. Because an unpredictable beacon picks the targets, a colluding ring cannot forge safe approvals in advance like a gale they can forecast; they must judge honestly or risk the penalty on every call. This turns cheap rubber-stamping, the sybil's favorite move, into a losing gamble that stains their stake like spilled pigment.
